verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents a built-in AI writing assistant inside Kit's email composer that drafts or refines subject lines or copy from a brief. The Kit MCP lets an external AI client draft broadcasts in the account, but that is a third-party client acting through an integration, not native composer AI. Subject-line A/B testing is a related but different feature.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can have the platform's built-in AI draft or refine subject lines and email copy from a brief, inside the composer
